headline: Australia to bar foreign students from bringing families
summary: Australia plans to stop international students from bringing partners and children, aiming to reduce net migration by 225,000 by 2028.
details: Australia is set to implement new rules preventing foreign students from bringing their partners and children to the country while they pursue their studies. This move is part of a broader strategy to tighten regulations for temporary migrants and reduce the overall net overseas migration.

The government aims to decrease net overseas migration to 225,000 by 2028, a significant drop from the current figure of approximately 300,000. Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke is expected to announce these changes in a speech.

Currently, international students are permitted to bring their spouses or partners, who can also work in Australia under certain conditions. Dependent children under 18 are also allowed to accompany students.

This policy shift appears to be influenced by the growing popularity of the hard-right One Nation party, which has advocated for drastic cuts to temporary migration. The party proposes reducing net overseas migration to 130,000 over three years.

Australia's migration numbers, particularly driven by international students, surged after the reopening of borders in February 2022. However, concerns have been raised about the strain on housing, infrastructure, and social cohesion due to the influx.

Official data shows net overseas migration reached 306,000 in the year ending June 30, 2025, with international students constituting over half of this total. The numbers have been trending downwards from a peak in 2023.

headline_marked: Messi's 100th goal: [[Inter Miami wins Campeones Cup]]
headline: Messi's 100th goal: Inter Miami wins Campeones Cup
summary: Lionel Messi scored his 100th goal for the club and provided an assist to lead Inter Miami to a 2-0 victory over Cruz Azul.
details: Inter Miami secured their first-ever Campeones Cup title on Wednesday, defeating Mexican side Cruz Azul 2-0 in the annual clash between MLS and Liga MX champions.
The victory was highlighted by Lionel Messi's 100th goal for the club, a rare diving header from a Luis Suarez cross in the 24th minute.
Messi continued to dominate the match, providing a corner that was headed home by Casemiro in the 81st minute to seal the win.
This marks Messi's first trophy of the year, coming two months after Argentina's loss in the 2026 World Cup final against Spain.
The win also marks a successful debut for new head coach Cristian 'Kily' Gonzalez, who took charge for the first time in this match.
Cruz Azul struggled to create clear chances, with Miami goalkeeper Dayne St Clair making key saves to keep a clean sheet.
The Campeones Cup is an annual competition pitting the previous year's MLS Cup winner against the winner of Mexico's Campeon de Campeones.
caption:
100 goals and another trophy! 🏆
Lionel Messi leads Inter Miami to Campeones Cup glory.

Inter Miami secured their first-ever Campeones Cup title on Wednesday, defeating Mexican side Cruz Azul 2-0 in the annual clash between MLS and Liga MX champions.

The victory was highlighted by Lionel Messi's 100th goal for the club, a rare diving header from a Luis Suarez cross in the 24th minute.

Messi continued to dominate the match, providing a corner that was headed home by Casemiro in the 81st minute to seal the win.

This marks Messi's first trophy of the year, coming two months after Argentina's loss in the 2026 World Cup final against Spain.

The win also marks a successful debut for new head coach Cristian 'Kily' Gonzalez, who took charge for the first time in this match.

Cruz Azul struggled to create clear chances, with Miami goalkeeper Dayne St Clair making key saves to keep a clean sheet.

The Campeones Cup is an annual competition pitting the previous year's MLS Cup winner against the winner of Mexico's Campeon de Campeones.
